decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a three condenser units to the to the existing office building would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original building, character of the area or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) ENV-1.5 (Noise Pollution) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
description: Installation of 3 x condenser units to the roof of the building.
